reason: A dsh web-surface monitoring plugin that retrieves configured provider balance or usage data through server-side proxy routes and displays it in a refreshable status panel.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面中通过服务端代理获取配置提供商的余额或用量，并以可刷新状态面板展示。
summaries.en: Displays configured provider balance or usage data in a refreshable dsh web-surface status panel through server-side proxy routes.

capabilities: Reads configured provider credentials through the host credential seam
Makes authenticated server-side requests to configured provider quota endpoints
Registers server-side proxy routes for quota data
Injects a status widget into the dsh web surface
Refreshes quota and usage data periodically
